en.text:
Passively grants 100 Guard Resistance and Guard Endurance to Swords.

While Guarding:
• Grants <pve 50% /> <pvp [10%] /> Damage Resistance (Stacks multiplicatively with the Damage Resistance provided by Sword Guard against blocked attacks)
• Blocking a hit grants 2 Stacks of Perfect Guard. Maximum of 100 Stacks. (Cannot gain stacks while you have the <solar/>Restoration buff)
• <heavy/>Heavy Ammo Sword Energy does not decay from holding guard

All Stacks are removed if no hits have been blocked in the last 10 seconds.

Dealing Sword Damage with active Perfect Guard Stacks grants <solar/>Restoration x2:
<pve 4 /> <pvp [3] /> second duration at 1 Stack, scaling up to <pve 16 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds at 100 Stacks. (<solar/>Ember of Solace increases this by 50%, up to <pve 24 /> <pvp [9] /> seconds)

// Guarding with Aggressive Frame Swords grants a total of <pve 95% /> <pvp [91%] /> Damage Resistance against blocked hits. These numbers drop to <pve 90% /> <pvp [82%] /> on other Sword Frames.
